verdict.rationale: Bulk operations, such as batch inference or acting on many models or chats at once, are a fair question for a local LLM runner, so the axis applies. The evidence pack documents no bulk or batch capability. The REST API, CLI commands (lms load, lms get) and headless daemon are developer building blocks a user could script loops around, which earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once
